reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was "200 mg" on the front, and then that it is two capsules per sachet, which is exactly the trick I look for. A brand with zero reviews on Amazon is a pass for me, I read the 1-star reviews first and there is nothing to read.
objection: No reviews at all, so I cannot check complaints about stomach upset, capsule size or whether the dose is real. A QR code is the brand's own claim until hundreds of other buyers back it up.
would_change_my_mind: Several hundred verified reviews with a decent share of 1-star ones I can read and find fair, plus the lab report on the QR showing the actual magnesium amount per capsule.
